workflow.title: Mac cleanup: browser traces or recurring storage growth?
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide between deliberate browser-data removal and investigating storage that keeps returning; do not promise deletion solves growth.
sections: Identify what must be retained: sessions, autofill and originals are not automatically junk
Read Mac feature scope, not Windows registry/driver claims
Choose a documented cleanup task or investigate time-correlated growth
Review location/method/rebuild costs; distinguish Trash from recovered space
Choose by documented task, with affiliation and preview/hosted limitations
workflow.interactionPass: Hand off a local-only decision checklist: browser-data removal, app removal or recurring-growth investigation; no filesystem access, uploads or automatic winner score.
workflow.visualPlan: Cleared CCleaner Mac UI after lead; selected example-data Breathing Room Activity preview later. Rights and contextual review remain pending.

ccleaner: Documents Mac browser-data scheduling, app removal, duplicates and Professional photo analysis. Choose it for a documented matching task, not invented absence elsewhere.
Home-use restriction documented; tier checkmarks, requirement conflict and price conditions unresolved. No safety/performance benchmark.
breathingRoom: Breathing Room, which we build, has source-documented grouped helpers, sampled history and developer-cache investigation; fit judgment, not tested superiority.
Non-notarized preview, Python requirement, incomplete runtime validation and hosted-data caveats must accompany recommendations.
Do not recommend replacing CCleaner just for photo/duplicate analysis or a production-ready notarized utility; Breathing Room parity for those tasks not established.
